## How it works

<h2>Developer integration</h2><p>Share the same cut with another reviewer by storing clipping planes in BCF. This page embeds three cuts in the pinned clinic's Z-up IFC coordinates and writes them with <code>bcf.save()</code>. <code>viewer.add()</code> imports each viewpoint; <code>viewer.selectTopic()</code> opens it. Use the Saved view options to switch cuts; one saved view is active at a time. Each example state demonstrates clipping, with a camera suited to its cut.</p><p>Copy this folder and serve it over HTTP, for example <code>python -m http.server 8080</code>. Open <code>http://localhost:8080/</code>; the SDK and sample downloads require internet access.</p>
<p>Component groups and project identifiers are queried from source bytes through the native <code>viewer.IfcAPI</code>. Colors, camera poses and cutting planes are authored BCF inputs.</p><p>The page opens the original source bytes with <code>await viewer.IfcAPI</code>, reads native model data, then closes the model and disposes WASM before displaying the source with <code>viewer.add()</code>. See the <a href="https://thatopen.github.io/engine_web-ifc/docs/classes/web-ifc.IfcAPI.html">complete web-ifc API reference</a>.</p>
